name: postonce
title: PostOnce
description: Publish and schedule posts to your social accounts with PostOnce, browse your posts and cancel scheduled ones. Requires a PostOnce account and API key.
author: nigel_yong

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Create a key under Developers in the PostOnce dashboard

commands.name: create-post
commands.title: Create Post
commands.description: Publish a post now or schedule it on your connected accounts

commands.name: search-posts
commands.title: Search Posts
commands.description: Browse your posts by status and cancel scheduled ones

commands.name: connected-accounts
commands.title: Connected Accounts
commands.description: List the social accounts connected to PostOnce

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
